_comment: Real output of the `openai-models` and `anthropic-models` plugins for the providers' deprecations pages, read 2026-10-13 by patch-it's hosted ingestion service and served with the stored row id as `id`, the way GET /v1/changes serves it. One event per retired model name, the name in `affected.value`; `affected.operation` is the provider's main model-taking call (`POST /v1/chat/completions`, `POST /v1/messages`); `version` is the shutdown date, `migration_hint` the replacement the provider names, and every `source_url` is a Wayback Machine snapshot of the page the event was read from. No hand edits.
